defaults_and_omissions: Storage keySource schema default Microsoft.Storage is recorded, but omitted native GET keySource is unresolved rather than manufacturing a current key declaration.
Omitted or empty keyversion is a versionless reference; explicit null is malformed. Pinned versions support the native 32-hex identifier syntax; other syntax unresolved.
Table keyType is required for a positive declaration; Service is a known opposite. enabled omission is not a disabled-encryption inference because native storage encryption cannot be disabled.
REST known link enums CustomLogs/AzureWatson/Query/Ingestion/Alerts are parsed; only Query is assessed. Retired CustomLogs behavior is not treated as a Query requirement.
